scope.change: The isolated routed deployment guard now performs every preflight, activation, readiness, and post-activation assertion through an explicit fail-closed boundary. The host fixture also supports the local Bash and filesystem variants used for verification.

failure_first.observed: A fixture with no readiness marker could reach deployment_status=success because the script relied on errexit for the final readiness assertion.

complete_package_suite.host_permission: The suite used only local loopback fixture listeners.

platform_qualification.native_linux_release_verifier: Skipped outside Linux; it remains mandatory on Linux and was not represented as passed locally.

deployment.reason: This is a source and fixture hardening commit. No new routed overlay archive or user-authorized production deployment was requested.

residual_risks: The active R85 release was not replaced by this candidate and still requires an independently built, pinned successor before deployment.
The Linux-native verification remains required on a Linux x64 release host before any release claim.
A real user-authorized two-account new-request E2E remains required for M6.9 completion; no semantic stream may be replayed or migrated after output begins.
No cross-account continuity, in-flight recovery, or stable performance claim is made.
